description: This file defines the ACLJSController class responsible for generating JavaScript code to enforce access control permissions in SuiteCRM modules, including dynamic script generation based on user permissions and module configurations.

classes.name: ACLJSController
classes.description: Controller class for generating ACL-related JavaScript for SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing module, form, and ownership status.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to enforce ACL permissions on the client side.

methods.name: getHTMLValues
methods.description: Returns HTML attribute values based on display options.

methods.name: getFieldByIdScript
methods.description: Generates script to disable HTML elements by ID if access is denied.

methods.name: getFieldByNameScript
methods.description: Generates script to disable HTML elements by name if access is denied.

methods.name: getFieldByFormScript
methods.description: Generates script to disable form fields within a specific form if access is denied.
